assessments.mechanism: Use dynamic, recently sourced, objectively scored benchmark slices as an assurance layer separate from development-tuned evaluations.
assessments.clean_scope: LiveBench-style contamination-resistant general LLM benchmarking; objective ground truth does not directly solve open-ended agent evaluation.
assessments.o_comparison: O already separates development/reference evidence from held-out and independent evidence, uses sealed expected values and deterministic scoring, and treats repository-authored tests as non-claim-grade. It has not implemented continuously refreshed recent-source benchmark slices or measured their contamination resistance.

assessments.mechanism: Meta-evaluate judges using controlled localized interventions that create verifiable process/evidence/report failures.
assessments.clean_scope: REFLECT evidence is for evidence-based research-agent traces; transfer to other agent families requires category-level validation.
assessments.o_comparison: O fail-closes evaluator provenance and uses deterministic checks, but no intervention-based meta-evaluation of an LLM judge was found.

assessments.mechanism: Attach per-instance judge reliability diagnostics using transitivity violations and calibrated/conformal prediction sets.
assessments.clean_scope: SummEval/NLG evidence; transfer to agent traces and binary/pairwise decisions is untested.
assessments.o_comparison: No conformal judge-reliability, transitivity-cycle, or per-instance prediction-set mechanism was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Validate reward-model benchmarks by predictive validity for downstream Best-of-N/RL behavior, not leaderboard discrimination alone.
assessments.clean_scope: RewardBench 2 evidence; strong Best-of-N correlation does not guarantee PPO quality and distribution/model lineage matters.
assessments.o_comparison: O uses task outcomes and protected regressions but has no reward-model benchmark or downstream RM predictive-validity study.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate process verifiers on OOD error-localization benchmarks and compare data-efficient generative verification.
assessments.clean_scope: Reasoning-domain ProcessBench/ThinkPRM evidence; broader tool-use/process transfer remains open.
assessments.o_comparison: No PRM/generative process-verifier training or OOD process-verifier benchmark is present in inspected O state.

assessments.mechanism: Use process-level supervision with active selection of informative steps when reliable intermediate labels are feasible.
assessments.clean_scope: Math reasoning evidence with costly human step labels; strongest result is domain-specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O records tool events and task evaluation but does not train process reward models or actively acquire step labels.

assessments.mechanism: Audit pairwise LLM judges for order stability and model-family/self-style preference before using their outputs as signals.
assessments.clean_scope: Pairwise LLM-as-judge studies; exact mitigation gain needs direct ablation.
assessments.o_comparison: O does not contain a pairwise LLM-judge order/self-preference audit in the inspected current snapshot.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate uncertainty with distinct calibration and error-ranking/selective-risk objectives rather than ECE alone.
assessments.clean_scope: Black-box LLM uncertainty/scientific-QA evidence; method ranking is task/format dependent.
assessments.o_comparison: O has PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN semantic verdicts, but no probabilistic calibration, abstention/selective-risk, or error-ranking benchmark; qualitative UNCERTAIN is not equivalent.
